questions.question: Around what share of consumers need to trust a brand before considering buying from it?
questions.answer: 8 in 10 - Around 4 in 5 consumers need to trust a brand to consider buying from it.

questions.question: What percentage of consumers prefer shopping with brands they follow on social media?
questions.answer: 77% - That many consumers prefer shopping with brands they follow on social media.

questions.question: Which factor influences about 65% of consumers when deciding to buy from a brand?
questions.answer: Brand’s CEO and employees’ behavior - 65% of consumers say that a brand’s CEO and employees influence their decision to buy.

questions.question: What share of a brand’s first impression comes from visual design?
questions.answer: 55% - Over half of brand first impressions are visual.

questions.question: How much does using color improve brand recognition?
questions.answer: Up to 80% - Color increases brand recognition by up to 80%.

questions.question: True or False: A large portion of job seekers check company reviews before applying for a job.
questions.answer: True - 86% of job seekers read company reviews before applying for a job.

questions.question: What percentage of brand marketers list building brand awareness as their top goal for social media?
questions.answer: 70% - 70% of brand marketers list building brand awareness as their top goal for social media.

questions.question: What is the effect of brand consistency on revenue, according to the stats?
questions.answer: Increases revenue by 10–20% - Brand consistency can increase revenue by 10-20%.

questions.question: True or False: More than half of brands enforce their brand guidelines strictly.
questions.answer: False - Almost half of brands publish off-brand content at least a few times per year; only 23% of brand professionals report never publishing off-brand content.
